correctness.rationale: For all kappa>=0 and all nonzero initial states, solve the polar inverse-square equation exactly: r(t)=r0 exp(-kappa t)/sqrt(1-z^T Q_{kappa,t} z). Q is a positive definite trigonometric Gram matrix at every t>0. Its determinant is [(1-exp(-2kt))^2-4k^2 exp(-2kt) sin^2 t]/[4k^2(1+k^2)] for k>0, and t^2-sin^2 t at k=0. Ellipse area is pi/sqrt(det). For k>0 the limiting nonescaping ellipse has area 2pi k sqrt(1+k^2); subtract it before taking a finite-lifespan tail. Uniform expansions establish the claimed algebraic neutral tail, damped oscillatory exponential law, and crossover at k*t fixed. Exact proof is in RESULT.md; standalone checker passed independent quadrature and numerical asymptotic diagnostics. No finite diagnostic is treated as proof of all-time statements.

originality.rationale: The existing general polar Bernoulli formula (Llibre 2024, Proposition 5) is not a novelty claim. The final claim instead computes the exact Euclidean area of all initial conditions still finite at each original-time horizon, subtracts the infinite-lifespan basin, obtains an oscillating exponential factor, and exhibits a uniform k*t crossover to the neutral algebraic tail. The checked primary results focus on radial integrability, limit-cycle existence and qualitative phase portraits; no inspected claim or indexed result states this lifetime-area identity for the same system. As every part is derivable by further analysis from the published radial solution, an independently derived equivalent area law outside inspected sources remains the main residual risk.
residual_risks: The explicit general radial solution in the 2024 source materially reduces the work to Gram-geometry and asymptotics; the result is a newly evaluated observable, not new integrability. A separate exact area evaluation could exist in unindexed papers.
The 2005 cubic classification was accessible in reproduced text form, not audited line-by-line as an independent publication. It cannot be used to claim global absence of every equivalent result.

Indexed nearby research records with different systems were compared using their indexed summaries, not all complete primary manuscripts; their different defining equations make direct parameter coverage implausible, but not logically impossible without detailed checking.
No independent expert mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.

value.rationale: For a natural 2024 cubic rigid flow, physical-time escape is unavoidable outside a genuine geometric separatrix; measuring the exact finite-horizon set of survivable initial states is mathematically meaningful independently of the known trajectory formula. The new quantity is a whole family of nested Euclidean ellipse areas and exact tails, not a handpicked finite computation. The neutral case has a pi/t area tail while every strictly positive damping has an exponentially small survivor shell whose prefactor oscillates between two different sharp values. A uniform kappa*t crossover supplies a nontrivial boundary asymptotic. This is useful for exact finite-time blow-up risk and validating numerical integration, with strictly limited claims.
